Oracle’s primary performance obligations with respect to software support contracts is to provide customers with technical support as needed and unspecified software product upgrades, maintenance releases and patches during the term of the support period, if and when they are available. Therefore, revenues for software support contracts is generally recognized ratably over the contractual periods that the support services are provided.
